sources: book.wvstateparks.com (shop/lodging page lists Bluestone Tent, Old Mill, Meador and East Shore campground filters; supplier scan between Blackwater Falls 11067324 and Cabwaylingo 11067393 electric found no Bluestone campsite supplier with anything for sale, 2026-10-21)

values.note: Four campgrounds, 120 sites in all. Meador: 32 sites for RVs and tents, seven with electric and water, fifteen electric only, central bathhouse, dump station. Old Mill: 33 rustic sites, 'not suggested for larger RVs and campers'. Tent Area: five rustic sites. East Shore: 12 primitive boat-in sites. Old Mill and East Shore are closed during the Bluestone Dam construction 'and will reopen once construction is completed'.

sites.source: https://wvstateparks.com/parks/bluestone-state-park/lodging/camping-at-bluestone-state-park/ ('Bluestone is home to four distinct campgrounds, with a combined total of 120 campsites'; Meador, Old Mill, Tent Area and East Shore paragraphs), read 2026-10-21

hookups.source: https://wvstateparks.com/parks/bluestone-state-park/lodging/camping-at-bluestone-state-park/ ('Meador Campground has 32 sites ... seven of which offer electric and water hookups. Fifteen sites are electric only.'), read 2026-10-21. Amperage not stated.

facilities.source: https://wvstateparks.com/parks/bluestone-state-park/lodging/camping-at-bluestone-state-park/ ('A dump station is available'; Meador and Old Mill each have 'a central bathhouse'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 'All Bluestone State Park campgrounds are open spring through fall, weather permitting.' No dates given.

The park's camping page states only the 14-night maximum and says dam construction 'will affect campsite availability. Before arriving, please check with the park office at 304-466-2805.' It omits the reservation and weekend-minimum sentences the other WV park pages carry, and the WV State Parks booking site sells only Bluestone's picnic shelters.

booking.source: https://wvstateparks.com/parks/bluestone-state-park/lodging/camping-at-bluestone-state-park/ ('There is a 14-night maximum stay'; 'Current construction on the Bluestone Dam will affect campsite availability') + book.wvstateparks.com (supplier 10988378 'Bluestone State Park Shelters' only), read 2026-10-21

summary: Added sites (120 in four campgrounds; Meador is the RV one), water at 7 sites, dump, spring-to-fall season and the 14-night max. Old Mill and East Shore closed for dam construction (partial closure, in sites.note). Not priced: no campsites on the booking site and no rate on the park pages. Note left.
flags: Inherited booking row looks wrong here: state:WV says reservable on book.wvstateparks.com with a 2-night weekend minimum, but the booking site sells no Bluestone campsites (only shelters) and the camping page drops the reservation and minimum-stay sentences. Probably first-come or phone-only during the dam work; worth a call to 304-466-2805.

Waterfront re-audit lead: the camping page calls Bluestone 'the perfect lakeside retreat camping spot, located along the state's third-largest body of water', and the entry's own note says 'lakeside campsites', while waterfront is 'not waterfront'.

Partial closure (dam construction): Old Mill (33 sites) and East Shore (12 boat-in) are closed 'and will reopen once construction is completed'; Meador stays open. Not a status, since the campground operates.
